baseline_prompt:
CANDIDATE BASELINE:
- Target Role: Junior / Junior+ Go Backend Developer (~1 year experience, SplitCore pet project).
- Core Tech Stack: Go (Golang), PostgreSQL, pgxpool, RabbitMQ, Docker, Clean Architecture, REST API, Linux.
- Additional: Learning Python (AI agents, basic RAG).
- Gaps / No Commercial Experience: Kubernetes (K8s), Apache Kafka, gRPC, high-scale microservices, AWS cloud architecture, complex CI/CD.
- HARD REJECT CRITERIA (Instant SKIP): Senior positions (3+ years required), non-Go primary languages (Java, PHP, C#, C++, Node.js), on-site outside Kyiv.

knowledge_chunks.content: Asynchronous event-driven architecture using RabbitMQ (amqp091-go). Implemented publisher and consumer channels with durable queues and acknowledgments (ACK/NACK) for instant Telegram user notifications.
Production PostgreSQL integration with pgxpool v5 in Golang. Implemented relational schema, connection pooling, SQL migrations, and strict ACID transaction safety for user balance transfers.
Clean Architecture / Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in Go. Decoupled domain business entities, repository interfaces, database adapters, and usecase interactors for zero circular dependencies.
Containerization with Docker and Docker Compose. Multi-stage Go builds, volume persistence for PostgreSQL data, and isolated network bridges.
High-performance RSS parser in Go using gofeed library. Downloads XML feeds from Djinni, parses vacancy items, and implements atomic deduplication in PostgreSQL via ON CONFLICT (guid) DO NOTHING.
Interactive Human-in-the-Loop Telegram Bot built with gopkg.in/telebot.v4 in Golang. Handles inline callback buttons, dynamic message editing, feedback routing, and tap-to-copy code formatting.
Structured logging in Go using standard log/slog with lumberjack file rotation. Graceful shutdown daemon with signal.NotifyContext handling SIGINT and SIGTERM without race conditions.
Deterministic multi-agent pipeline in Python using Google Gemini API. Structured Outputs enforced via Pydantic schemas, RabbitMQ prefetch QoS consumer with pika.
